why: Found when I66-P2's test first ran on the build's evidence set (I66 build, after holon evidence --milestone M2). Its last assertion compared the view's E3 positions, sorted as strings, with the key's thresholds.view_e3_predicted, which lists the same eight [p, where] pairs in guard order (finalizeBatch's guards[9] before guards[11]); as strings 'guards[11]' sorts before 'guards[9]', so the two lists differ in order alone. The first version of the test (the prereg reviewed as da7eb3fe) sorted both sides; the fold that read the pairs from the key sorted only one. The amended assertion sorts the pinned list too. The claim is unchanged: I66-P2 names the eight positions without an order, the assertions before this one (the instrument's re-indexing of the abstraction's E3 atoms, eight of them, with the same operands, reason and src) passed as written, and the set of positions is the pinned one.

Found when I66-R2's test first ran on the build (after holon historical exit --milestone M2). Its last assertion required that no why of a view-keyed not_replayed entry contain the words 'the hand abstraction'. But rule V7 has a replayed action's why quote the view's own extraction method, which reads 'generated by holon.differential: the window view of spec/M2/facts/morph_rollup.extracted.json over the hand abstraction, its unmatched requires removed' (gen/M2/extracted/m1_view.json, which rule V1 forbids I66 to change), so the words are there by rule, in a true sentence. The assertion meant the false sentence the prereg review found (finding m2): I23's generic 'the hand abstraction of <action> (...)', which named the view a hand abstraction. The amended assertion checks that no view-keyed why starts with 'the hand abstraction of '; TestBuild.test_the_exit_document_names_the_window_view checks every view-keyed why exactly. R2's claim text in the key ('none says the hand abstraction') is frozen and reads, with V7, as that sentence. Every other assertion of the test is unchanged.

Found when the test first ran on the build. Its first assertion compared the sorted stems of the light copy's window views with the list [morph_rollup, m1_view], which is not in sorted order ('m1_view' sorts first), so it failed before the checks it guards. The amended assertion sorts the expected list too; the copy has exactly these two views, as meant. The test's claims are unchanged and hold: on the same light copy, run by hand before the amendment, holon diagram exits 1 ('a window view has a fact document's model name: [morph_rollup]') and writes nothing, and holon evidence exits 1 and writes nothing.

I72 (tests_m3/test_e2_transitions.py rule Z7, preregistered with I72 in spec/M3/predictions.json; I33's evidence key) computes E2 over the adopted holon-facts/0.3 transitions documents in M2's evidence set, so the adopted Rollup document's model morph_rollup.extracted, which had no atom at I66's prereg (I20's anchors-only coverage), gains E2 atoms. The test compared every non-view atom of gen/M2/evidence.json with I66's prereg; the amended comparison leaves out exactly the E2 atoms of the adopted transitions documents' models (facts_version holon-facts/0.3, diagram null), which I72-P1 checks against I72's instrument. Every other assertion (the models, the other models' atoms and every unresolved entry as at I66's prereg, the header, the inputs, the view's model, the hashes and the registry) is unchanged.

I72 (tests_m3/test_e2_transitions.py rule Z7; the I72 prereg review's B2) computes E2 over the adopted holon-facts/0.3 transitions documents in M2's evidence set, so a light copy's `holon evidence --milestone M2` (a target milestone's build from the committed diagrams, which adopts the Rollup document) carries the adopted model's E2 atoms that I66's prereg set lacks. The test compared the two sets byte for byte; amended, it compares them as JSON with the adopted transitions documents' models' E2 atoms and the evidence_sha256 left out on both sides. That still checks what the test is for: nothing but the view's model separates the light copy's set from I66's prereg set. Every other assertion is unchanged.
